Prepared NYC Departure Records for 2013

flight_data.Rd

All source flight rows, with airline names and scheduled departure periods. Missing departure delays are retained, not imputed.

Usage

flight_data

Format

A data frame with 336776 rows and nine columns:

date

Scheduled departure date.

month

Month number from 1 to 12.

origin

NYC origin airport code: EWR, JFK or LGA.

destination

Destination airport code.

carrier

Two-letter airline code.

airline

Airline name from the source lookup table.

scheduled_hour

Scheduled local departure hour, 0 to 23.

period

Night (00-05), Morning (06-11), Afternoon (12-17), or Evening (18-23), based on scheduled local departure time.

dep_delay

Departure delay in minutes. Negative values mean early departures. Missing values are retained.

Source

Prepared from nycflights13 version 1.0.2, by Hadley Wickham. The upstream data are distributed under CC0: https://nycflights13.tidyverse.org/. Original flight data: RITA Bureau of Transportation Statistics, as recorded at https://nycflights13.tidyverse.org/reference/flights.html.

Details

The reproducible script is data-raw/prepare-flights.R in the repository. These data describe 2013 operations, not current booking conditions. A missing delay is not classified as a cancellation or an on-time departure.

Examples

head(flight_data)
#>         date month origin destination carrier                airline
#> 1 2013-01-01     1    EWR         IAH      UA  United Air Lines Inc.
#> 2 2013-01-01     1    LGA         IAH      UA  United Air Lines Inc.
#> 3 2013-01-01     1    JFK         MIA      AA American Airlines Inc.
#> 4 2013-01-01     1    JFK         BQN      B6        JetBlue Airways
#> 5 2013-01-01     1    LGA         ATL      DL   Delta Air Lines Inc.
#> 6 2013-01-01     1    EWR         ORD      UA  United Air Lines Inc.
#>   scheduled_hour          period dep_delay
#> 1              5   Night (00-05)         2
#> 2              5   Night (00-05)         4
#> 3              5   Night (00-05)         2
#> 4              5   Night (00-05)        -1
#> 5              6 Morning (06-11)        -6
#> 6              5   Night (00-05)        -4
table(flight_data$origin)
#> 
#>    EWR    JFK    LGA 
#> 120835 111279 104662
